dispositions.name: commons-configuration:commons-configuration
dispositions.reason: The only installed external bytecode references are four ESAPI policyloader classes. The exact image config selects DefaultAccessController, not ExperimentalAccessController; there is no untrusted configuration/policy upload or mounted ESAPI configuration in the declared bank topology. Trusted immutable classpath settings do not satisfy this advisory's untrusted configuration or attacker-controlled usage precondition. This is not a claim that commons-configuration is absent.
